title: Tarjima asoslari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ma’no bo‘yicha tarjima qilasiz, o‘zbek va ingliz tillaridagi soxta do‘st so‘zlardan qochasiz, rasmiy va norasmiy uslubni almashtirasiz hamda tayyor tarjimani ma’no, fakt va til bo‘yicha tekshirib tahrir qilasiz.

scenes.title: Tarjima asoslari
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bugun yangi turdagi dars boshlaymiz. Shu paytgacha ingliz tilida bevosita gapirdingiz, endi o‘zbek va ingliz tillari o‘rtasida ko‘prik quramiz. Tarjimon lug‘at emas: u ma’noni, ohangni va maqsadni bir tildan ikkinchisiga olib o‘tadi, keyin natijani tekshiradi. Dars oxirida siz so‘zma-so‘z emas, ma’no bo‘yicha tarjima qilasiz, ikki tildagi soxta do‘st so‘zlardan qochasiz, rasmiy va norasmiy uslubni almashtirasiz va tayyor tarjimani o‘zingiz tekshirib tahrir qilasiz. Bu ko‘nikma ish, o‘qish va imtihonda juda qimmat.
scenes.say: Welcome to a new kind of lesson. So far you have used English directly. Today we build a bridge between Uzbek and English. A translator is not a dictionary. A translator carries meaning, tone and purpose from one language into another, and then checks the result.
scenes.say_uz: Yangi turdagi darsga xush kelibsiz. Shu paytgacha ingliz tilidan bevosita foydalandingiz. Bugun o‘zbek va ingliz tillari o‘rtasida ko‘prik quramiz. Tarjimon lug‘at emas. U ma’noni, ohangni va maqsadni bir tildan boshqasiga olib o‘tadi va natijani tekshiradi.

scenes.title: Ma’no bo‘yicha tarjima
board: unit of translation = the sentence, not the word

examples.t: I am going to Tashkent tomorrow.
His business took off.
Nice to meet you.

scenes.say_native: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima ko‘pincha xato bo‘ladi, chunki tillar ma’noni turlicha tashkil qiladi. O‘zbek tilida fe’l gap oxirida: „Men ertaga Toshkentga boraman“. Inglizchada ega, keyin fe’l: „I am going to Tashkent tomorrow“. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, inglizchada „a“, „the“ ni tanlash kerak. Shuning uchun bitta so‘zni emas, butun gapni o‘qing va o‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu nimani anglatadi va ingliz tilida ona tili egasi buni qanday aytadi? Masalan, „Siz bilan tanishganimdan xursandman“ ni so‘zma-so‘z „I am happy that I met you“ deb emas, „Nice to meet you“ deymiz. Tarjima birligi — so‘z emas, fikr.
scenes.say: Word-for-word translation usually fails because languages organise meaning differently. Uzbek puts the verb at the end, while English puts the subject first, then the verb. Uzbek has no articles. Always read the whole sentence, ask what it means and how a native speaker would say it, and only then write. The unit of translation is the idea, not the single word.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zma-so‘z tarjima ko‘pincha xato bo‘ladi, chunki tillar ma’noni turlicha tashkil qiladi. O‘zbek tilida fe’l gap oxirida, inglizchada ega, keyin fe’l keladi. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q. Butun gapni o‘qing, ma’nosini so‘rang va faqat shundan keyin yozing. Tarjima birligi — fikr.

scenes.title: Xato: so‘zma-so‘z tarjima
board: ✗ I am from Tashkent city located

examples.t: Your help means a lot to me.
It is not worth the effort.

scenes.say_native: So‘zma-so‘z tarjimaning ikkita ogohlantiruvchi belgisi bor. Birinchisi: inglizcha g‘alati eshitiladi. Masalan, „boshim og‘riyapti“ ni so‘zma-so‘z o‘girib bo‘lmaydi, ingliz tilida „I have a headache“ deymiz. Ikkinchisi: o‘zbek qolipi ko‘chiriladi, masalan fe’lni oxirga qo‘yish. O‘rniga xuddi shu vazifani bajaradigan tabiiy inglizcha iborani toping. „Bunga urinishning keragi yo‘q“ ni „it is not worth the effort“ deymiz. „Yordamingiz men uchun juda qadrli“ — „Your help means a lot to me“. Tekshirish usuli: tarjimani baland ovozda o‘qing. Agar quloqqa g‘alati tuyulsa, qaytadan ma’no bo‘yicha yozing.
scenes.say: Two warning signs of literal translation. First, the English sounds odd: my head is aching me is not how people say I have a headache. Second, structures are copied from Uzbek, such as putting the verb at the end. Instead, find the natural English expression with the same function. An Uzbek sentence saying that an attempt is pointless becomes it is not worth the effort, not there is no need of the effort of this.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zma-so‘z tarjimaning ikki belgisi bor. Birinchisi: inglizcha g‘alati eshitiladi. Ikkinchisi: o‘zbek tuzilmasi ko‘chiriladi, masalan fe’lni oxirga qo‘yish. Xuddi shu vazifani bajaradigan tabiiy inglizcha iborani toping. Tarjimani baland ovozda o‘qib tekshiring.

scenes.title: Mashq: ma’no bo‘yicha tarjima
board: 3) Bu yerda parkovka qilish mumkin emas.
scenes.say_native: Uchta o‘zbekcha gapni tabiiy inglizchaga ma’no bo‘yicha tarjima qiling. Birinchisi: boshim og‘riyapti. Ikkinchisi: sizga rahmat, yordamingiz katta bo‘ldi. Uchinchisi: bu yerda parkovka qilish mumkin emas. Inglizcha variantlarni baland ovozda ayting. So‘zma-so‘z o‘girmang, avval ma’noni o‘ylang: odamlar bu gapni inglizchada qanday aytadi?
scenes.say: Put three ideas into natural English, by meaning and not word for word. One: your head hurts. Two: you thank someone because their help was very big. Three: you tell a driver that parking is not allowed here. Say your English versions aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta o‘zbekcha gapni tabiiy inglizchaga ma’no bo‘yicha tarjima qiling. Boshim og‘riyapti. Sizga rahmat, yordamingiz katta bo‘ldi. Bu yerda parkovka qilish mumkin emas. Inglizcha variantlarni baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: ma’no bo‘yicha
board: Thank you, you have been a great help.
You cannot park here. / No parking.

examples.t: I have a headache.
Thank you, you have been a great help.

scenes.say_native: Tabiiy variantlar: „I have a headache.“ „Thank you, you have been a great help.“ Uchinchisi vaziyatga bog‘liq: og‘zaki ogohlantirish bo‘lsa „You cannot park here“, yozma belgi bo‘lsa shunchaki „No parking“. Ko‘ryapsizmi, bitta o‘zbekcha gapning inglizcha varianti matn qayerda ko‘rinishiga qarab o‘zgaradi: yozma e’lon og‘zaki gapdan qisqa bo‘ladi. Shuning uchun tarjimadan oldin o‘zingizdan so‘rang: bu matn kimga, qayerda va nima uchun yozilgan? „Yordamingiz katta bo‘ldi“ ni „your help was big“ deb o‘girmaganingiz yaxshi. Inglizchada „a great help“ ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: The natural versions are: I have a headache. Thank you, you have been a great help. And for the sign or the spoken warning: you cannot park here, or simply no parking on a sign. Notice that the third translation depends on the situation. A written notice is shorter than a spoken sentence, so ask yourself where the text will appear.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy variantlar: I have a headache. Thank you, you have been a great help. Uchinchisi vaziyatga bog‘liq: og‘zaki ogohlantirishda you cannot park here, belgi uchun no parking. Tarjimadan oldin so‘rang: matn kimga, qayerda va nima uchun yozilgan?

scenes.title: Soxta do‘stlar

examples.t: I bought a magazine at the kiosk.
What is your surname?
The actual cost was higher than expected.

scenes.say_native: Soxta do‘stlar — ikki tilda o‘xshash eshitiladigan, lekin ma’nosi boshqa so‘zlar. O‘zbek tilidagi „magazin“ — do‘kon, ingliz „magazine“ esa jurnal. „Familiya“ — „surname“, inglizcha „family“ esa oila. „Aktual“ — dolzarb, ingliz „actual“ esa haqiqiy: „the actual cost“ — haqiqiy xarajat. „Kabinet“ — xona yoki ish xonasi, inglizcha „cabinet“ esa shkafcha yoki hukumat a’zolari kengashi. Bu so‘zlarni eshitganda „tanish“ degan taassurotga ishonmang. Eng xavfli soxta do‘stlar — aynan sizga tanish ko‘ringanlari. Ularning ro‘yxatini yuriting va har bir shubhali so‘zni lug‘atdan tekshiring.
scenes.say: False friends are words that look or sound alike in two languages but mean different things. The Uzbek word for a shop sounds like the English magazine, which is a periodical. The Uzbek word for a last name sounds like family, but the English word for last name is surname. The Uzbek word meaning topical sounds like actual, but English actual means real. And the Uzbek word for an office sounds like cabinet, which means a cupboard or a government body.
scenes.say_uz: Soxta do‘stlar — ikki tilda o‘xshash ko‘rinadigan, lekin ma’nosi boshqa so‘zlar. O‘zbekcha magazin do‘kon, inglizcha magazine jurnal. Familiya surname, family esa oila. Aktual dolzarb, actual esa haqiqiy. Kabinet ish xonasi, cabinet esa shkaf yoki hukumat a’zolari.

scenes.title: Xato: eventually va actually

examples.t: We eventually found the file after an hour.
examples.uz: Biz bir soatdan keyin fayl oxir-oqibat topdik.

examples.t: Actually, I disagree with that figure.

scenes.say_native: Yana ikkita tuzoq. „Eventually“ „ehtimol“ degani emas. U „oxir-oqibat, ma’lum vaqtdan keyin“ ni bildiradi: „we eventually found the file“ — oxiri faylni topdik. „Actually“ esa „hozirda“ degani emas. U „aslida, haqiqatda“ ma’nosida, ko‘pincha tuzatish uchun: „Actually, the meeting is on Friday“ — aslida yig‘ilish juma kuni. „Hozirda“ uchun „currently“, „at the moment“ yoki „at present“ ishlating. Ehtimol uchun „perhaps“, „possibly“ yoki „maybe“. Rus tilida ham shunday soxta do‘stlar bor, shuning uchun rus tili orqali kelgan so‘zlarga ham ehtiyot bo‘ling. Tarjima qilishdan oldin so‘zni lug‘atdan tekshiring.
scenes.say: Two more traps. Eventually does not mean possibly. It means in the end, after some time. And actually does not mean currently. It signals the real situation, often a correction: actually, the meeting is on Friday. For currently, use at the moment or at present. Look at the English word in a dictionary, not only at its look.
scenes.say_uz: Yana ikki tuzoq. Eventually ehtimol degani emas: u oxir-oqibat degani. Actually esa hozirda degani emas: u aslida degani, ko‘pincha tuzatish uchun. Hozirda uchun currently yoki at the moment, ehtimol uchun perhaps ishlating. So‘zni lug‘atdan tekshiring.

scenes.title: Mashq: soxta do‘stlarni tuzating
board: 1) I read an interesting magazin yesterday.
2) Eventually, he may come to the meeting.
3) Actually, I am working abroad (= hozirda)
scenes.say_native: Soxta do‘stlarni tuzating. Birinchisi: „I bought a shop magazine yesterday“, o‘zbekcha „magazin“ ma’nosida do‘kon nazarda tutilgan. Ikkinchisi: „Eventually he may come to the meeting“, ma’nosi — ehtimol. Uchinchisi: „Actually I am working abroad“, ma’nosi — hozirda. Har bir gapni to‘g‘ri so‘z bilan baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Fix the false friends. One: I bought a shop magazine yesterday, meaning a shop. Two: Eventually he may come to the meeting, meaning perhaps. Three: Actually I am working abroad, meaning at present. Say the corrected sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Soxta do‘stlarni tuzating. I bought a shop magazine yesterday, bu yerda do‘kon nazarda tutilgan. Eventually he may come to the meeting, ma’nosi ehtimol. Actually I am working abroad, ma’nosi hozirda.

scenes.title: Javoblar: soxta do‘stlar
board: I went to a shop yesterday. (store)
Perhaps he will come to the meeting.

examples.t: I am currently working abroad.

scenes.say_native: To‘g‘rilangan variantlar: „I went to a shop yesterday“, Amerikada „store“. „Perhaps he will come to the meeting.“ „I am currently working abroad.“ Birinchi gapda „magazine“ soxta do‘st edi, uni „shop“ bilan almashtirdik. Ikkinchi va uchinchi gapda „eventually“ va „actually“ noto‘g‘ri ma’noda ishlatilgan edi. Eslab qoling: tanish ko‘ringan so‘z — tekshirish uchun belgi, ishonch uchun emas. Britaniya va Amerika variantini ham yodda tuting: do‘kon Britaniyada „shop“, Amerikada ko‘pincha „store“. Tarjima qilganda auditoriyangizni bilib oling.
scenes.say: Corrected versions. I went to a shop yesterday, or a store in American English. Perhaps he will come to the meeting. I am currently working abroad. In the first sentence, the word magazine was the false friend and should be replaced by shop. In the second and third, eventually and actually were used in the wrong meaning.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘rilangan variantlar. Kecha do‘konga bordim, Amerikada store. Ehtimol, u yig‘ilishga keladi. Men hozirda chet elda ishlayapman. Tanish ko‘ringan so‘z — tekshirish uchun belgi.

scenes.title: Uslubni ko‘chirish
board: siz / sen → one English "you", tone through wording

examples.t: Could you possibly send me the report by Friday?
examples.uz: Hisobotni juma kuniga qadar yuborib bera olasizmi?

examples.t: Please send the report by Friday.
examples.uz: Iltimos, hisobotni juma kuniga qadar yuboring.

examples.t: Send me the report by Friday, will you?

scenes.say_native: Uslub — rasmiylik darajasi. O‘zbek tilida hurmat „siz“ va „sen“ hamda fe’l qo‘shimchalari orqali ko‘rsatiladi. Ingliz tilida „you“ bitta, shuning uchun hurmat so‘zlar tanlovi orqali ifodalanadi. Rasmiy iltimos „would“, „could“ va „kindly“ bilan: „Could you possibly send me the report by Friday?“ Neytral iltimos „please“ bilan. Norasmiy iltimos qisqa shakl va tag-savol bilan: „Send me the report by Friday, will you?“ Bir xil o‘zbekcha gap uchta xil inglizcha variantni talab qilishi mumkin. Uslubni tanlash uchun uchta savolni bering: kim yozyapti, kimga yozyapti va qayerda o‘qiladi.
scenes.say: Register is the level of formality. Uzbek shows politeness with its formal and informal forms of you and with verb endings. English has one you, so politeness moves into the wording. A formal request uses would, could and kindly. A neutral one uses please. An informal one uses short forms and tag questions. The same Uzbek sentence can need three different English versions.
scenes.say_uz: Uslub — rasmiylik darajasi. O‘zbek tilida hurmat siz va sen hamda fe’l qo‘shimchalarida ko‘rinadi. Inglizchada you bitta, shuning uchun hurmat so‘zlar tanlovida namoyon bo‘ladi. Rasmiy iltimos would, could, kindly bilan. Neytral iltimos please bilan. Norasmiy iltimos qisqa shakl va tag-savol bilan.

scenes.title: Xato: uslubni aralashtirish
board: ✗ Dear Sir, send me the contract, bro
✓ Dear Mr Smith, could you please send me the contract?
✗ Hereby I am kindly asking you to be so kind

examples.t: I am writing to enquire about the vacancy.
examples.uz: Men bo‘sh ish o‘rni haqida so‘rash uchun yozyapman.

examples.t: We would be grateful if you could confirm receipt.

scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — uslublarni aralashtirish. Rasmiy salomlashuv, o‘rtasida esa sleng — beparvolikdek ko‘rinadi. Teskari xato — haddan tashqari rasmiy, ko‘chirma til. O‘zbek rasmiy qoliplari, masalan „Sizdan marhamat qilib so‘raymiz“, so‘zma-so‘z o‘girilsa, „hereby I am kindly asking you to be so kind“ bo‘lib qoladi va ingliz tilida qotib eshitiladi. Rasmiy xatda tabiiy qolip: „I am writing to enquire about…“ yoki „We would be grateful if you could…“. Bitta darajani tanlang va oxirigacha saqlang. Qisqartmalar, masalan „don’t“, norasmiy va neytral nutqqa xos, rasmiy yozuvda odatda ishlatilmaydi.
scenes.say: The common mistake is mixing registers. A formal opening with slang in the middle looks careless. The opposite mistake is overformal, copied language, such as hereby I am kindly asking you to be so kind. This is a translation of Uzbek formal formulas, and it sounds stiff in English. Choose one level and keep it until the end. Contractions belong to informal and neutral speech, while formal writing usually avoids them.
scenes.say_uz: Eng keng tarqalgan xato — uslublarni aralashtirish. Rasmiy boshlanishdan keyin sleng beparvolikdek ko‘rinadi. Teskari xato — o‘zbek rasmiy qoliplarini so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirish. Bitta darajani tanlang va oxirigacha saqlang. Qisqartmalar rasmiy yozuvda odatda ishlatilmaydi.

scenes.title: Mashq: uslubni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Bitta fikrni ikki uslubda tarjima qiling: „Ertaga kela olmasangiz, menga xabar bering.“ Birinchisi: menejeringizga, rasmiy uslubda. Ikkinchisi: yaqin hamkasbingizga, norasmiy uslubda. Ikkala variantni baland ovozda ayting. Rasmiyda „would“ yoki „could“, norasmiyda qisqa shakl ishlating.
scenes.say: Say this idea in two registers: tell me tomorrow if you cannot come. First, write it for your manager, in a formal register. Second, for a close colleague, in an informal register. Say both versions aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Bitta fikrni ikki uslubda tarjima qiling: ertaga kela olmasangiz, menga xabar bering. Birinchisi menejeringizga, rasmiy uslubda. Ikkinchisi yaqin hamkasbingizga, norasmiy uslubda.

scenes.title: Javoblar: uslublar
board: Formal: I would be grateful if you could let me know tomorrow if you cannot attend.
Informal: Let me know tomorrow if you can’t make it.

examples.t: Let me know if you can’t make it.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy variant: „I would be grateful if you could let me know if you are unable to attend tomorrow.“ Norasmiy variant: „Let me know tomorrow if you can’t make it.“ Farqlarni solishtiring: uzunlik, modal fe’l, qisqartma va „make it“ — kelishga ulgurmoq, bu ibora norasmiy nutqda tabiiy. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, lekin har biri o‘z vaziyatiga mos. Menejerga norasmiy variantni yozsangiz, hurmatsizlik bo‘lishi mumkin. Hamkasbga rasmiy variantni yozsangiz, g‘alati va sovuq eshitiladi. Shuning uchun tarjimadan oldin auditoriyani aniqlab oling.
scenes.say: Formal version: I would be grateful if you could let me know if you are unable to attend tomorrow. Informal version: let me know tomorrow if you can't make it. Compare the length, the modal verb, the contraction and the verb make it, which is idiomatic for being able to come. Both are correct, but each fits only its own setting.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy variant: I would be grateful if you could let me know if you are unable to attend tomorrow. Norasmiy variant: let me know tomorrow if you can’t make it. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, lekin har biri o‘z vaziyatiga mos. Tarjimadan oldin auditoriyani aniqlang.

scenes.title: Tarjimani tekshirish va tahrirlash

examples.t: The meeting is on 5 March at 14:30.
The terms must be used consistently throughout.
examples.uz: Atamalar butun matn bo‘ylab bir xil ishlatilishi kerak.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi qoralamani hech qachon topshirmang. Bir necha bosqichda tahrir qiling. Birinchi: ma’no — hech narsa qo‘shilmaganmi yoki tushib qolmaganmi? Ikkinchi: faktlar — raqamlar, ismlar, sanalar. Uchinchi: til — grammatika, artikllar, imlo va atamalar izchilligi. Bir xil tushuncha bir xil so‘z bilan berilsin: bir joyda „invoice“, boshqa joyda „bill“ yozmang. To‘rtinchi: baland ovozda o‘qing va qiyin gapni teskari tarjima qiling, ya’ni inglizchadan o‘zbekchaga, ma’no saqlanganini ko‘rish uchun. Sanalarni ham tekshiring: o‘zbekcha „5 mart“ inglizchada Britaniyada „5 March“, Amerikada „March 5“.
scenes.say: Never submit a first draft. Edit in passes. First, check meaning: has anything been added or left out? Second, check facts: numbers, names and dates. Third, check language: grammar, articles, spelling and consistent terminology. Finally, read it aloud and, if possible, back-translate a difficult sentence into Uzbek to see whether the meaning survives.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi qoralamani topshirmang. Bir necha bosqichda tahrir qiling. Ma’noni, so‘ng faktlarni, so‘ng tilni tekshiring. Oxirida baland ovozda o‘qing va qiyin gapni teskari tarjima qiling.

scenes.title: Xato: raqam va atamalar

examples.t: The total was 1,250 dollars.
Use one term for one concept.
examples.uz: Bitta tushuncha uchun bitta atama ishlating.

scenes.say_native: Raqamlar — tuzoq. O‘zbek va rus tillarida o‘nli kasrda vergul, minglikda bo‘sh joy ishlatiladi: „14,5 mln“, „1 250“. Inglizchada o‘nli kasrda nuqta, minglikda vergul: „14.5 million“, „1,250“. Bu farqni sezmasangiz, summa mingga o‘zgarib ketishi mumkin. Ismlar egasi ishlatadigan shaklda yozilsin, sanalar noaniq bo‘lmasin: „05/03“ Britaniyada 5 mart, Amerikada 3 may bo‘lishi mumkin, shuning uchun oyni so‘z bilan yozing. Va nihoyat, bitta tushuncha uchun butun hujjatda bitta atama ishlating. Atama almashsa, o‘quvchi ikkita turli narsa deb o‘ylashi mumkin.
scenes.say: Numbers are a trap. Uzbek and Russian use a comma for decimals and a space for thousands, while English uses a point for decimals and a comma for thousands: fourteen point five million, one thousand two hundred and fifty. Names must be spelled in the form used by the person, and dates must be unambiguous. Finally, keep one term for one concept throughout the document.
scenes.say_uz: Raqamlar tuzoq. O‘zbek va rus tillarida o‘nli kasrda vergul ishlatiladi, inglizchada nuqta. Minglikda inglizchada vergul. Ismlar egasi ishlatadigan shaklda yozilsin, sanalar noaniq bo‘lmasin, oy so‘z bilan yozilsin. Bitta tushuncha uchun bitta atama ishlating.

scenes.title: Mashq: qoralamani tahrir qiling
board: Draft: "The meeting will held on 05/03. The total is 14,5 million. Please sent me the bill."
scenes.say_native: Qoralamani tahrir qiling: „The meeting will held on 05/03. The total is 14,5 million. Please sent me the bill.“ To‘rtta muammoni toping: fe’l shakli, sana, raqam yozilishi va „please“ dan keyingi fe’l. Tuzatilgan variantni baland ovozda ayting. Xatolarning birinchisi „will“ dan keyin nima kelishini bilishingizga bog‘liq.
scenes.say: Edit this draft. The meeting will held on oh-five slash oh-three. The total is fourteen comma five million. Please sent me the bill. Find four problems: the verb form, the date, the number format and the verb after please.
scenes.say_uz: Qoralamani tahrir qiling. The meeting will held on 05/03. The total is 14,5 million. Please sent me the bill. To‘rtta muammoni toping: fe’l shakli, sana, raqam yozilishi va please dan keyingi fe’l.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tahrir

examples.t: The meeting will be held on 5 March.

scenes.say_native: To‘g‘rilangan matn: „The meeting will be held on 5 March. The total is 14.5 million. Please send me the invoice.“ To‘rtta muammo: birinchi, „will“ dan keyin majhul nisbatda „be“ tushib qolgan; ikkinchi, sana noaniq edi, oyni so‘z bilan yozdik; uchinchi, o‘nli kasrdagi vergul nuqtaga almashdi; to‘rtinchi, „please“ dan keyin fe’lning bosh shakli „send“ kerak, „sent“ emas. Agar butun hujjatda „invoice“ ishlatilgan bo‘lsa, „bill“ o‘rniga „invoice“ deb yozish ham izchillikni saqlaydi. Shu tekshiruvlarni har safar bajarsangiz, xatolar keskin kamayadi.
scenes.say: The corrected text is: the meeting will be held on 5 March. The total is 14.5 million. Please send me the invoice. The four problems were the missing be in the passive after will, the ambiguous date, the decimal comma, and the wrong verb form after please, which needs the base form send. Also consider using invoice in place of bill if that is the term used in the rest of the text.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘rilangan matn: yig‘ilish 5 mart kuni o‘tkaziladi, jami 14.5 million, iltimos, hisob-fakturani yuboring. To‘rtta muammo: majhul nisbatda be tushib qolgan, sana noaniq edi, o‘nli kasrdagi vergul nuqtaga almashdi, please dan keyin bosh shakldagi send kerak edi.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: tarjimonlar muhokamasi
board: B: That is a false friend.
B: Yes, or "topical", depending on context.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbat — ikki tarjimon qoralamani muhokama qiladi. Birinchisi: qoralamani endi tugatdim, ikkinchi bandda „aktual“ ni „actual“ deb o‘girdim. Ikkinchisi: afsuski, bu soxta do‘st, ingliz tilida „actual“ haqiqiy degani, sizga „relevant“ kerak, joriy yangiliklar haqida bo‘lsa „topical“. Birinchisi: unda tuzataman va boshqa atamalarning izchilligini tekshiraman. Eshiting: „I am afraid“ — tuzatishni yumshatadi, „depending on context“ — kontekstga qarab.
scenes.say: I have just finished the draft. In the second paragraph I translated the Uzbek word for relevant as actual. That is a false friend, I am afraid. In English, actual means real. You probably want relevant, or topical if you are talking about current news. Then I will correct it and check the other terms for consistency.
scenes.say_uz: Qoralamani endi tugatdim. Ikkinchi bandda aktual so‘zini actual deb o‘girganman. Afsuski, bu soxta do‘st. Inglizchada actual haqiqiy degani. Sizga ehtimol relevant kerak, joriy yangiliklar haqida bo‘lsa topical. Unda tuzataman va boshqa atamalarning izchilligini tekshiraman.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) Which two words does B suggest?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Tarjimon qaysi so‘zni noto‘g‘ri o‘girgan? Inglizcha „actual“ aslida nimani anglatadi? Ikkinchi so‘zlovchi uning o‘rniga qaysi ikkita inglizcha so‘zni tavsiya qiladi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: Three questions. Which word did the translator get wrong? What does the English word actual really mean? And which two English words does the second speaker suggest instead?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Tarjimon qaysi so‘zni noto‘g‘ri o‘girgan? Inglizcha actual nimani anglatadi? Ikkinchi so‘zlovchi qaysi ikkita so‘zni tavsiya qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: Noto‘g‘ri tarjima qilingan so‘z — „aktual“. Inglizcha „actual“ — haqiqiy. Ikkinchi so‘zlovchi „relevant“ ni, joriy yangiliklar bo‘lsa „topical“ ni tavsiya qiladi. To‘g‘ri tanlov kontekstga bog‘liq, shuning uchun tarjimon doim asl matn nima demoqchi ekanini o‘ylashi kerak. Bu suhbatda yana bir foydali narsa bor: kasbdoshingizning xatosini „you are wrong“ demasdan, „that is a false friend, I am afraid“ deb aytish ham uslub masalasi.
scenes.say: The mistranslated word was the Uzbek word for relevant, which became actual. Actual in English means real. The second speaker suggests relevant, or topical for current news. The right choice depends on context, so a translator must always think about what the original text is trying to say.
scenes.say_uz: Noto‘g‘ri tarjima qilingan so‘z aktual edi. Actual inglizchada haqiqiy. Ikkinchi so‘zlovchi relevant yoki joriy yangiliklar uchun topical ni tavsiya qiladi. To‘g‘ri tanlov kontekstga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: mijoz bilan kelishuv
board: Client: Can you translate this contract into Uzbek?
Translator: Yes. Who will read it?
Client: Our lawyers, so it must be precise.
Translator: Then I will keep a glossary and send a query list.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat — tarjimon va mijoz. Mijoz: bu shartnomani hafta oxirigacha o‘zbek tiliga o‘gira olasizmi? Tarjimon: albatta, uni kim o‘qiydi? Mijoz: bizning yuristlar, shuning uchun aniq bo‘lishi kerak. Tarjimon: unday bo‘lsa, asosiy atamalarning qisqa lug‘atini tuzaman va matnni yakunlashdan oldin savollar ro‘yxatini yuboraman, hech narsa taxminga qolmasligi uchun. Diqqat: „who will be reading it“ — auditoriyani so‘rash, „glossary“ — atamalar lug‘ati, „query list“ — savollar ro‘yxati.
scenes.say: Can you translate this contract into Uzbek by the end of the week? Of course. Who will be reading it? Our lawyers, so it needs to be precise. In that case, I will build a short glossary of key terms and send you a list of queries before I finalise the text, so that nothing is left to guesswork.
scenes.say_uz: Bu shartnomani hafta oxirigacha o‘zbek tiliga o‘gira olasizmi? Albatta. Uni kim o‘qiydi? Bizning yuristlar, shuning uchun aniq bo‘lishi kerak. Unday bo‘lsa, asosiy atamalarning qisqa lug‘atini tuzaman va matnni yakunlashdan oldin savollar ro‘yxatini yuboraman, hech narsa taxminga qolmasligi uchun.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) What two things will the translator prepare?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Qaysi hujjatni, qaysi tilga o‘girish kerak? Uni kim o‘qiydi? Va tarjimon matnni yakunlashdan oldin qaysi ikki narsani tayyorlaydi? To‘liq gap bilan javob bering va auditoriya tarjimaga qanday ta’sir qilishini o‘ylang.
scenes.say: Questions. What document must be translated, and into which language? Who will read it? And what two things will the translator prepare before finalising the text?
scenes.say_uz: Savollar. Qaysi hujjatni, qaysi tilga o‘girish kerak? Uni kim o‘qiydi? Tarjimon matnni yakunlashdan oldin qaysi ikki narsani tayyorlaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
board: a glossary and a query list
scenes.say_native: Shartnomani o‘zbek tiliga o‘girish kerak. Uni mijozning yuristlari o‘qiydi. Tarjimon asosiy atamalarning qisqa lug‘atini va savollar ro‘yxatini tayyorlaydi. O‘quvchilar yuristlar bo‘lgani uchun aniqlik va atamalar izchilligi chiroyli uslubdan muhimroq. Ko‘ryapsizmi, auditoriya tarjimaning usulini belgilaydi: adabiy matnda erkinlik mumkin, yuridik matnda esa aniqlik birinchi o‘rinda. Endi bugungi hamma ko‘nikmani birlashtiramiz.
scenes.say: A contract must be translated into Uzbek. The client's lawyers will read it. The translator will prepare a short glossary of key terms and a list of queries. Because the readers are lawyers, precision and consistent terminology matter more than elegance.
scenes.say_uz: Shartnomani o‘zbek tiliga o‘girish kerak. Uni mijozning yuristlari o‘qiydi. Tarjimon atamalar lug‘ati va savollar ro‘yxatini tayyorlaydi. O‘quvchilar yuristlar bo‘lgani uchun aniqlik chiroyli uslubdan muhimroq.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bandni tarjima qiling
board: Uzbek: "Hurmatli hamkasblar, yig‘ilish payshanba kuni soat 10:00 ga ko‘chirildi. Iltimos, hisobotlarni oldindan yuboring."
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Quyidagi e’lonni rasmiy inglizchaga tarjima qiling: „Hurmatli hamkasblar, yig‘ilish payshanba kuni soat 10:00 ga ko‘chirildi. Iltimos, hisobotlarni oldindan yuboring.“ Keyin to‘rtta narsani tekshiring: ma’no, faktlar, grammatika va uslub. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Final task. Express this announcement in formal English: the colleagues are addressed respectfully, the meeting is moved to Thursday at ten o'clock, and reports are requested in advance. Then check four things: meaning, facts, grammar and register.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. E’lonni rasmiy inglizchaga tarjima qiling: hurmatli hamkasblar, yig‘ilish payshanba kuni soat o‘nga ko‘chirildi, iltimos, hisobotlarni oldindan yuboring. Keyin ma’no, fakt, grammatika va uslubni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Namuna tarjima
board: Dear colleagues, the meeting has been moved to Thursday at 10:00.
Kindly send your reports in advance.

examples.t: The meeting has been moved to Thursday at 10:00.
examples.uz: Yig‘ilish payshanba kuni soat 10:00 ga ko‘chirildi.

scenes.say_native: Namuna: „Dear colleagues, the meeting has been moved to Thursday at ten o’clock. Kindly send your reports in advance.“ Faktlar saqlandi: payshanba va soat o‘n. „Has been moved“ — hozirgi tugallangan zamonning majhul nisbati, chunki o‘zgarish hozir ham dolzarb. „Kindly“ — rasmiy, lekin tabiiy iltimos. „Hurmatli“ ni „Dear“ deb berdik, „respected“ deb emas: „respected colleagues“ ingliz tilida g‘alati eshitiladi. Bu klassik so‘zma-so‘z tuzoq. Tarjimangiz boshqacha so‘zlardan iborat bo‘lsa ham, mazmuni va uslubi shu bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Dear colleagues, the meeting has been moved to Thursday at ten o'clock. Kindly send your reports in advance. This keeps the facts, the day and the time, uses the present perfect passive for a change that is still relevant, and chooses a formal but natural request with kindly.
scenes.say_uz: Hurmatli hamkasblar, yig‘ilish payshanba kuni soat o‘nga ko‘chirildi. Iltimos, hisobotlarni oldindan yuboring. Faktlar saqlandi, hozirgi tugallangan majhul zamon dolzarb o‘zgarishni bildiradi, kindly esa rasmiy, lekin tabiiy iltimosdir.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
board: edit: meaning, facts, language, read aloud
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Birinchi: g‘oyani tarjima qiling, so‘zni emas. Ikkinchi: tanish ko‘ringan so‘zlarga shubha bilan qarang, „magazine“, „actual“, „eventually“ kabi soxta do‘stlarni tekshiring. Uchinchi: uslubni o‘quvchiga moslang: rasmiy, neytral yoki norasmiy. To‘rtinchi: har doim bosqichma-bosqich tahrir qiling: ma’no, faktlar, til, keyin baland ovozda o‘qing. Bu odatlar sizni oddiy tarjimadan professional tarjimaga olib boradi.
scenes.say: Let us recap. Translate the idea, not the word. Be suspicious of familiar-looking words. Match the register to the reader. And always edit in passes: meaning, facts, language, and then read it aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa. G‘oyani tarjima qiling, so‘zni emas. Tanish ko‘ringan so‘zlarga shubha bilan qarang. Uslubni o‘quvchiga moslang. Doim bosqichma-bosqich tahrir qiling: ma’no, faktlar, til, keyin baland ovozda o‘qing.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Check: meaning, facts, register, consistent terms
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa ikki qismdan iborat. Taxminan 150 so‘zli matnni o‘zbekchadan inglizchaga, xuddi shunday uzunlikdagi boshqa matnni inglizchadan o‘zbekchaga tarjima qiling. Ikkalasini ham bosqichma-bosqich tahrir qiling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ma’no to‘liq saqlangan, faktlar to‘g‘ri, uslub mos va atamalar izchil bo‘lsa. Keyingi darsda izchil, ya’ni konsekutiv tarjimaga kirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework has two parts. Translate a text of about one hundred and fifty words from Uzbek into English, and another of the same length from English into Uzbek. Edit both in passes. Next lesson: an introduction to consecutive interpreting. See you then.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz ikki qismdan iborat. Taxminan 150 so‘zli matnni o‘zbekchadan inglizchaga, xuddi shunday uzunlikdagi boshqa matnni inglizchadan o‘zbekchaga tarjima qiling. Ikkalasini tahrir qiling. Keyingi dars: konsekutiv tarjimaga kirish.

homework_uz: Taxminan 150 so‘zli matnni o‘zbekchadan inglizchaga va xuddi shunday uzunlikdagi boshqa matnni inglizchadan o‘zbekchaga tarjima qiling. Ikkalasini ma’no, fakt, uslub va atamalar izchilligi bo‘yicha tahrir qiling. Keyingi dars: konsekutiv tarjimaga kirish.
